rationale: I halved `acquireWait` in `tunables.go` from `HangTimeout/4` (500ms) to `HangTimeout/8` (250ms). Requests that can't get a hashing slot now get a 503 shed sooner instead of queueing. That should trim the queueing tail behind p95 latency, at the cost of a possible small success-rate loss if load queues requests for longer than 250ms. I haven't built it or run any load, so the effect is untested.
